category_title: Preschool girls performing meanness and aggression through 'sassy girl' play routines
scenario_title: Socio-dramatic play and verbal disapproval during lunch
minimal_context: The students are sitting with their peers and teachers during lunch time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, let's sit down at the table and eat our lunch.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Standing by the table with hands on her hips, looking at the boys) We're sassy girls. We're sassy girls.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit down and focus on your food.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Teasing the boys across the table) Don't mess with me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, no, we're not doing that, guys. Sorry.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whispering to her friend) Okay, well we're just going to be sassy, but they won't know.
